newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan market dominated by bank sales.
newsitem.headline: Jordan market dominated by bank sales.

text.p: Jordanian shares maintained a downward trend on Sunday but block sales in bank stock raised turnover in generally quiet trade, dealers said.
The official Amman Financial Market (AFM) index shed 0.18 percent to 152.15 points in a high turnover of 1,205,808 dinars ($1.7 million) dominated by a few large sales, mostly in bank stocks.
Block sales of Bank of Jordan and Arab Banking Coporation on Sunday alone accounted for over two thirds of daily volume.

The market continued to be underpinned by bargain hunting by mostly local investors in a handful of speculative and blue-chip stock prompted by recent falls which have made current price levels attractive, brokers said.

"There were block sales on a number of stocks ... and an improvement in prices on certain firms, but activity in the parallel market lead the market today," said Husam Hanbali from the Jordanian branch of Arab Banking Corporation's brokerage arm.
Political uncertainty combined with a lack of liquidity has recently depressed sentiment and prompted outside buyers and institutional investors to remain on the sidelines.
Among the handful of busy stock were Jordan New Cable Company which shed 0.01 dinars to 0.88 dinars and Jordan Selpho Chemicals which rose 0.03 dinars to 0.78 dinars in trade worth 25,916 dinars.
Jordan Electric Power rose 0.01 dinars to 1.67 in trade worth 22,391 dinars while a 0.50 dinars drop in market heavyweight Arab Bank to 256.00 dinars dragged the market lower.
The market on Sunday saw 17 shares rising while eleven fell. Another 18 were traded but closed unchanged.
The private Pearl Index of the 45 best performing shares in terms of turnover and financial performance rose 0.07 percent to 80.15 points, 3.89 percent down from the start of the year.
